name: flink
title: Flink
description: Send DataSet jobs to an Apache Flink cluster.
label: transformation,bigdata

properties.name: collect
properties.description: Indicates if results should be collected or counted.

properties.name: dataSetCallback
properties.description: Function performing action against a DataSet.

properties.name: dataStreamCallback
properties.description: Function performing action against a DataStream.

properties.name: checkpointingMode
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Checkpointing mode: EXACTLY_ONCE (default) or AT_LEAST_ONCE. EXACTLY_ONCE provides stronger guarantees but may have higher overhead.

properties.name: checkpointInterval
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Interval in milliseconds between checkpoints. Enables checkpointing when set. Recommended for streaming jobs to ensure fault tolerance.

properties.name: checkpointTimeout
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Timeout in milliseconds for checkpoints. Checkpoints that take longer will be aborted.

properties.name: executionMode
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Execution mode for the Flink job. Options: STREAMING (default), BATCH, AUTOMATIC. BATCH mode is recommended for bounded streams (batch processing).

properties.name: jobName
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Name for the Flink job. Useful for identification in the Flink UI and logs.

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: maxParallelism
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Maximum parallelism for the Flink job. Defines the upper bound for dynamic scaling and the number of key groups for stateful operators.

properties.name: minPauseBetweenCheckpoints
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Minimum pause in milliseconds between consecutive checkpoints. Helps prevent checkpoint storms under heavy load.

properties.name: parallelism
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Parallelism for the Flink job. If not set, uses the default parallelism of the execution environment.
